description: Sequence placement of FdeD relative to all Swiss-Prot small Rieske proteins with assigned partners
code:
import requests, re, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# ---- 1. Fetch sequences of the 37 reviewed small Rieske proteins + FdeD ----
u=("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=(xref:pfam-PF00355)+AND+(reviewed:true)+AND+(length:[80 TO 170])"
   "&fields=accession,id,protein_name,sequence,length&format=json&size=200")
res=requests.get(u,timeout=120).json()["results"]
seqs={}; cls={}
def classify(nm):
    n=nm.lower()
    if "cytochrome" in n or "menaquinol" in n or "periplasmic rieske" in n: return "bc1/b6f respiratory Rieske"
    if "nitrite reductase" in n: return "nitrite reductase small subunit"
    if "monooxygenase" in n and ("toluene-4" in n or "alkene" in n or "methanesulfonate" in n): return "diiron multicomponent monooxygenase Fd"
    if "sulredoxin" in n: return "sulredoxin (archaeal, partner unknown)"
    return "ring-hydroxylating dioxygenase Fd"
for r in res:
    pdx=r.get("proteinDescription",{})
    nm=pdx["recommendedName"]["fullName"]["value"] if pdx.get("recommendedName") else ""
    k=r["uniProtkbId"]
    seqs[k]=r["sequence"]["value"]; cls[k]=classify(nm)
FDED="MYLCHITQLPENGARGFDTESAGQATIFVLRRGDQVRAWRDSCPHHGTPLPWRRDAYFDGTGQHLVCAAHGALFDPLTGVCTLGPCQGDTLTAVPLRIDDDGGLHVDAGDPL"
seqs["FdeD_HERSS"]=FDED; cls["FdeD_HERSS"]="query (Hsero_1006)"
# drop redundant HCAC/NDOA duplicates for readability but keep one of each
keep=[]
seen=set()
for k in seqs:
    base=k.split("_")[0]
    if base in seen and base in ("HCAC","NDOA","QCRA","SDX","TODB"): continue
    seen.add(base); keep.append(k)
print("proteins compared:", len(keep))

# ---- 2. pairwise global alignment identity (Needleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62-free simple scoring) ----
def nw_identity(a,b,gap=-8,ext=-1):
    # affine-free simple NW with match=+2 mismatch=-1
    n,m=len(a),len(b)
    S=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=np.int8)
    S[0,1:]=np.arange(1,m+1)*gap; S[1:,0]=np.arange(1,n+1)*gap
    P[0,1:]=2; P[1:,0]=1
    A=np.frombuffer(a.encode(),dtype=np.uint8); B=np.frombuffer(b.encode(),dtype=np.uint8)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        match=np.where(A[i-1]==B, 2.0, -1.0)
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=S[i-1,j-1]+match[j-1]; up=S[i-1,j]+gap; lf=S[i,j-1]+gap
            best=max(d,up,lf); S[i,j]=best
            P[i,j]=0 if best==d else (1 if best==up else 2)
    i,j=n,m; ident=0; alen=0
    while i>0 or j>0:
        p=P[i,j]
        if p==0: ident+= (a[i-1]==b[j-1]); i-=1; j-=1
        elif p==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
        alen+=1
    return 100.0*ident/min(n,m)

names=keep
M=np.zeros((len(names),len(names)))
for i in range(len(names)):
    for j in range(i+1,len(names)):
        v=nw_identity(seqs[names[i]],seqs[names[j]]); M[i,j]=M[j,i]=v
qi=names.index("FdeD_HERSS")
tab=pd.DataFrame(dict(protein=names, group=[cls[n] for n in names], pct_id_to_FdeD=M[qi].round(1)))
tab=tab[tab.protein!="FdeD_HERSS"].sort_values("pct_id_to_FdeD",ascending=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",200); pd.set_option("display.max_rows",60)
print(tab.to_string(index=False))
print("\nBest hit to FdeD among characterised small Rieske proteins:",
      tab.iloc[0].protein, tab.iloc[0].pct_id_to_FdeD, "%", "|", tab.iloc[0].group)
print("Median identity to the ring-hydroxylating-dioxygenase ferredoxin clade:",
      round(tab[tab.group=="ring-hydroxylating dioxygenase Fd"].pct_id_to_FdeD.median(),1), "%")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,6))
colors={"ring-hydroxylating dioxygenase Fd":"#2f6f9f","diiron multicomponent monooxygenase Fd":"#e0a030",
        "nitrite reductase small subunit":"#7a56a6","bc1/b6f respiratory Rieske":"#c05c4a",
        "sulredoxin (archaeal, partner unknown)":"#777777"}
t=tab.iloc[::-1]
ax.barh(t.protein, t.pct_id_to_FdeD, color=[colors[g] for g in t.group])
ax.axvline(25, ls="--", c="k", lw=0.8)
ax.text(25.4, 0.5, "25% identity", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("percent identity to FdeD (Hsero_1006), global Needleman-Wunsch")
ax.set_title("FdeD is not closely related to any Rieske protein with an\nexperimentally assigned electron-transfer partner", fontsize=11)
import matplotlib.patches as mp
ax.legend(handles=[mp.Patch(color=v,label=k) for k,v in colors.items()], fontsize=7, loc="lower right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
